mainActivity.description: Explore safety through narrative
activities: Créer fin alternative ou nouvelle histoire
Commencer livre de classe sur sécurité
mainActivity.visualSupports: Livre illustré, images pour discussion, matériaux de création
mainActivity.movementBreak: Mime des actions de l'histoire

closing.description: Connect story lessons to real life
activities: Partage d'idées pour notre livre de classe
closing.visualSupports: Images de l'histoire, début du livre de classe

decisionPoints.situation: Which stories resonate most with students?
decisionPoints.ifThen: IF students connect to family stories → include more family safety | IF students like adventure → choose empowering adventure stories

decisionPoints.situation: How to choose diverse, inclusive stories?
decisionPoints.ifThen: IF class is diverse → ensure representation in story characters | IF limited diversity → still choose inclusive stories

decisionPoints.situation: What discussion questions are most valuable?
decisionPoints.ifThen: IF students analytical → deeper 'why' questions | IF students concrete → 'what would you do' questions

emergencyBackup.ifTooAdvanced: Focus on simple story listening and one discussion question
emergencyBackup.ifNotEngaged: More interactive storytelling with student participation
emergencyBackup.ifSensitive: Choose very gentle, positive stories only

lessons.realWorldConnection: Stories help us understand how safety concepts work in different situations and places
lessons.assessmentOpportunities: Listen to story discussions and connections to safety learning
lessons.differentiationSupport: Story lovers: opportunities to retell | Visual learners: focus on illustrations

lessons.title: Art corporel positif
lessons.goal: Students will create art celebrating body diversity and self-acceptance
lessons.connectionToPrevious: Extension: Reinforces body positivity and safety concepts through creative expression
materials: Crayons de couleur diverses de peau
safetyConsiderations: Célébrer toutes les formes de corps

opening.description: Set up body-positive art creation
opening.visualSupports: Matériaux colorés, exemples d'art corporel positif

mainActivity.description: Create art celebrating body diversity
activities: Créer autoportrait ou portrait de famille
Collage de corps divers et beaux
Art des 'super pouvoirs' de nos corps
mainActivity.visualSupports: Matériaux variés, exemples inspirants, espace d'exposition
mainActivity.movementBreak: Danse libre célébrant nos corps en mouvement

closing.description: Celebrate artistic expression and body positivity
activities: Discussion: 'Ce que j'aime de mon art'
Affirmation: 'Mon corps et mon art sont uniques'

decisionPoints.situation: How to celebrate all body types and abilities?
decisionPoints.ifThen: IF students focus on differences → redirect to 'different and wonderful' | IF students compare → emphasize uniqueness as strength

decisionPoints.situation: What art materials work best?
decisionPoints.ifThen: IF students prefer drawing → more drawing materials | IF students like 3D → add clay or construction materials

decisionPoints.situation: How to address body image positively?
decisionPoints.ifThen: IF negative comments arise → gently redirect to positive aspects | IF students confident → celebrate and model positivity

emergencyBackup.ifTooAdvanced: Simple drawings of happy people with focus on smiles
emergencyBackup.ifNotEngaged: More hands-on materials and collaborative art
emergencyBackup.ifSensitive: Very positive focus, avoid any body details, focus on faces and hearts

lessons.realWorldConnection: Art helps us express our feelings about ourselves and celebrate what makes each person special
lessons.assessmentOpportunities: Observe body-positive language and self-acceptance in art creation
lessons.differentiationSupport: Artistic students: more complex projects | Less confident: guided step-by-step creation

lessons.title: Chansons de sécurité
lessons.goal: Students will learn and create songs about safety concepts
lessons.connectionToPrevious: Extension: Reinforces safety vocabulary and concepts through music and rhythm

opening.description: Connect music to learning and memory
activities: Révision en chantant une chanson connue
Introduction: 'La musique nous aide à apprendre'

mainActivity.description: Learn and create safety songs
activities: Créer nouveaux verses pour mélodie connue
mainActivity.visualSupports: Instruments, paroles visuelles, espace de performance
mainActivity.movementBreak: Included in musical activities and dancing

closing.description: Celebrate musical safety learning
activities: Discussion: 'Comment la musique aide à retenir'
Plan pour partager chansons avec familles
closing.visualSupports: Espace de performance, enregistrements des chansons

decisionPoints.situation: Which safety concepts work well in song?
decisionPoints.ifThen: IF students remember body parts song → add safety rules song | IF students like rhythm → focus on chanted safety rules

decisionPoints.situation: What musical styles engage students?
decisionPoints.ifThen: IF students like fast music → upbeat safety songs | IF students prefer calm → gentle, reassuring songs

decisionPoints.situation: How to make songs memorable and fun?
decisionPoints.ifThen: IF students love repetition → songs with choruses | IF students like movement → action songs with gestures

emergencyBackup.ifTooAdvanced: Simple singing of one safety song with clapping
emergencyBackup.ifNotEngaged: More movement and instruments, less complex creation
emergencyBackup.ifSensitive: Very gentle, reassuring songs only

lessons.realWorldConnection: Songs help us remember important safety rules and make learning fun and memorable
lessons.assessmentOpportunities: Listen to safety vocabulary retention through songs
lessons.differentiationSupport: Musical learners: lead song creation | Shy students: instrument playing instead of singing

lessons.title: Famille et sécurité
lessons.goal: Students will explore how different families talk about and practice safety
lessons.connectionToPrevious: Extension: Connects school safety learning with home and family practices

opening.description: Honor family diversity and safety practices

mainActivity.description: Explore family safety practices
activities: Partage volontaire: 'Ma famille et la sécurité'
Créer carte de remerciement pour famille
mainActivity.visualSupports: Espace de partage, matériaux de création, cartes familiales
mainActivity.movementBreak: Mime des activités familiales sécuritaires

closing.description: Appreciate family support in safety
activities: Affirmation: 'Ma famille m'aide à rester en sécurité'
Plan pour partager apprentissage avec famille
closing.visualSupports: Cartes pour familles, plans de partage

decisionPoints.situation: How to honor diverse family approaches to safety?
decisionPoints.ifThen: IF cultural differences emerge → celebrate 'different ways to care' | IF conflicts arise → focus on 'all families want us safe'

decisionPoints.situation: What family sharing is appropriate?
decisionPoints.ifThen: IF students share openly → guide to appropriate details | IF students private → respect and don't pressure

decisionPoints.situation: How to support all family structures?
decisionPoints.ifThen: IF diverse structures → explicitly include all in language | IF questions arise → 'families come in many wonderful forms'

emergencyBackup.ifTooAdvanced: Simple drawing of family keeping us safe
emergencyBackup.ifNotEngaged: More hands-on family appreciation activities
emergencyBackup.ifSensitive: Keep focus very positive, avoid detailed family sharing

lessons.realWorldConnection: Families are important partners in keeping us safe, each in their own special way
lessons.assessmentOpportunities: Listen to understanding of family role in safety
lessons.differentiationSupport: Diverse families: validate all family types | Private students: alternative expression methods

lessons.title: Célébration de sécurité
lessons.goal: Students will celebrate their safety learning and commit to ongoing safety practices
lessons.connectionToPrevious: Extension: Culminates the unit with celebration and commitment to safety practices
safetyConsiderations: Inclure tous les étudiants dans célébration
Préparer pour émotions de fin d'unité

opening.description: Set up celebration of learning journey

mainActivity.description: Celebrate safety learning achievements
activities: Partage: 'La chose la plus importante que j'ai apprise'
Engagement: 'Comment je vais utiliser cet apprentissage'
mainActivity.visualSupports: Portfolios complets, certificats, espace de présentation
mainActivity.movementBreak: Danse de célébration de la sécurité

closing.description: Commit to ongoing safety practices with confidence
activities: Affirmation: 'Je sais comment rester en sécurité'
Plan pour continuer à apprendre sur la sécurité

decisionPoints.situation: How can we celebrate learning appropriately?
decisionPoints.ifThen: IF students love ceremony → formal certificate presentation | IF students prefer low-key → quiet individual recognition

decisionPoints.situation: What commitments are realistic for students?
decisionPoints.ifThen: IF students ready for commitments → specific safety promises | IF students need simpler → general 'I will stay safe' promise

decisionPoints.situation: How to end the unit positively and confidently?
decisionPoints.ifThen: IF students confident → celebrate independence | IF students need reassurance → emphasize continued adult support

emergencyBackup.ifTooAdvanced: Simple certificate ceremony with one sharing opportunity
emergencyBackup.ifNotEngaged: More active celebration with music and movement
emergencyBackup.ifSensitive: Quiet, gentle celebration focusing on growth and care

lessons.realWorldConnection: Celebrating our learning helps us remember how important safety knowledge is in our daily lives
lessons.assessmentOpportunities: Final comprehensive assessment through portfolios and presentations
lessons.differentiationSupport: All learning styles: multiple ways to celebrate and demonstrate growth
